meta.title: Fix web app screen loading
meta.body_summary: Introduce a lazyScreen helper to wrap dynamic imports in Suspense for consistent lazy loading of React screen components across navigation modules, aiming to fix screen loading issues.

perf_labels.notes: Codex introduced lazyScreen helper for Suspense lazy loading; maintainer tested and found it non-functional, closing in favor of another PR.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: A small change of 104 lines across 8 files, typical for a targeted fix. As a small-step performance PR it was closed—not merged—due to functional failure discovered by the maintainer.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer transphorm commented that the solution doesn't work and closed the PR in favor of a different implementation.
review_details.performance_claim: Lazy screen loading via Suspense wrapper improves screen load performance and avoids 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer stated PR doesn't work and closed in favor of another PR; no substantive review beyond bot nitpicks.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Frontend lazy loading with React Suspense and code-splitting; Codex failed to produce a working implementation despite the small change size, indicating difficulty in getting Suspense boundaries correct for this codebase.

detection_detail.manual_testing: Maintainer transphorm manually tested the web app and observed that the fix did not resolve the loading issue.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or reproduction steps; closure based on anecdotal failure.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; a subsequent PR (#814) was created as the preferred solution.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced a lazyScreen utility that wraps dynamic React.lazy imports in a Suspense boundary with a fallback View; refactored all navigation modules (aesop, dev, passport, prove, recovery, settings) to use lazyScreen instead of direct React.lazy; removed top-level Suspense wrapper from index.tsx.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All navigation files were updated to use the new lazyScreen helper, removing direct React.lazy calls.
change_trajectory: First commit (7b876b9): Added lazyScreen.tsx and updated all navigation files to use it.
Second commit (d467e4d): Removed top-level Suspense wrapper from index.tsx, relying on lazyScreen's internal Suspense.

review_signals.summary: CodeRabbit bot provided design suggestions for improving type safety and reducing boilerplate, but no blocking issues.
Author stated the solution doesn't work and closed the PR in favor of a different approach.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with lazyScreen helper and navigation updates.
CodeRabbit bot reviewed within minutes with nitpick suggestions.
Author commented shortly after that the solution doesn't work and closed the PR in favor of another PR.
